summary: Generated artifacts for project phase4230243t3. FastAPI service with SQLite and pytest tests. Deployment notes: Run with uvicorn, use DATABASE_URL for SQLite connection.

files.content:
FROM python:3.10-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD [

version: '3'
services:
  app:
    build: .
    ports:
      - 8000:8000
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///database.db
    volumes:
      - .:/app
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: sqlite:3
    volumes:
      - db-data:/data
volumes:
  db-data:

name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python 3.10
        uses: actions/setup-python@v3
        with:
          python-version: 3.10
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest
